items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: Albemarle appears well-positioned to benefit as EV demand grows globally. Lithium demand is expected to grow on the back of significant global EV penetration, with Albemarle projecting 10-20% CAGR for lithium demand from 2025 to 2030. ALB stock carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 7.8% and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.
